rules.statement: Do not put agent attribution in commit messages: no `Co-authored-by:` trailer naming an AI agent account (such as Copilot or `copilot-swe-agent[bot]`), no `Claude-Session:` line, and no "Generated with [Claude Code" line.
rules.why: GitHub builds the contributor list from commit authors and Co-authored-by trailers, and that list should name only accountable people. Removing a trailer later means rewriting and force-pushing published history.
rules.check: Look in the commit messages of the PR for Co-authored-by lines naming an AI agent, Claude-Session lines, or 'Generated with Claude Code' footers.

rules.statement: Commits must have a person as author and committer, not an AI agent or bot account; re-author agent-created commits before they merge.
rules.why: The contributor graph is a list of accountable people, and agent-authored commits put the agent on it even when no trailer names it.
rules.check: Check the PR's commits for an author or committer that is an agent account (for example `copilot-swe-agent[bot]` or a `+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com` email).

rules.statement: Keep AI tool commit-attribution settings off in versioned editor and agent configuration: Claude Code's `attribution` set to off in `.claude/settings.json`, and VS Code's `git.addAICoAuthor` set to `off` in `.vscode/settings.json`.
rules.why: The setting must live in a versioned file so it reaches every session, tool and clone, which an instruction given to one session cannot do.
rules.check: Flag diffs to `.claude/settings.json` or `.vscode/settings.json` that turn on or remove these attribution settings.

rules.statement: A commit-msg hook that enforces attribution must strip agent attribution lines silently, not reject the commit.
rules.why: Rejecting a commit interrupts an automated flow over an attribution detail, and a blocked agent just retries. Stripping cannot be worked around, cannot fail a batch, and leaves messages that are already correct untouched.
rules.check: In changes to git hooks such as `.githooks/commit-msg`, look for code that exits non-zero on agent trailers when it should remove them and exit 0.
